description:
In this feature we are implementing new activity landing pages for each of the process (CI, Upgrade, Validaiton Process)

In this wiki we are focusing on creating new Activity Landing Page for eahc processes.

For each Activity type like Build And Test we will have a new route in the current navigation header we have like existing "Business Processes" , "Tests", "Environments" and add new ones at the beginnig called "Business & Test Activity",, "Validation Actiivty", and "Upgrade Activity"

On click of this page, we will see for each activity like "Build & Test" the current executions of type "Build & Test" in a 2 tables. One showing the active excutions with status pending_input or running, and other hidden under Show PRevious button that showe other statuses when clicked.

 

Also as part of this page, users now we will be able to start a BP execution insead of relying on the existing page in the Available Processes where thety currently check the table of processes and click the run button"

This feature is not concerned about removing legacy pages, it is only about creating the new component and activity landing pages.

We need to maintain same columns with their filters as existing tables. Including the My Build functionality which is equivalenbt to the existing "MY Executions" button.

 

The cards in the screenshot below that shows "Pending Input", "Running", etc... are out of scope 

 

To start a new Execution/Build users click on the Build Button.

A dialog is opened, showing a table with available processes and a run button. There is also a dropdown where users can filter the processes by the sub family.

On click on run, in the same dialog we move to a new page inside it hsowing the inputs needed to runb the execution/build and a Build Button at the end. There is also a backj button to go back the available processes if needed.
